EPG.allowed_use: Direct EPG presynaptic edges may use modeled sign +1 in a restricted mechanistic heading probe.
EPG.forbidden_inference: Catalog-predicted acetylcholine does not establish heading tuning, firing rate, synaptic efficacy, or behavioral steering.

Delta7.allowed_use: Delta7 may be retained as structural and literature-guided sensitivity evidence.
Delta7.forbidden_inference: Do not infer an effective postsynaptic sign from glutamate identity alone under the conservative fly-sniff sign policy.

literature_context.summary: Published PFL3 work treats EPG and Delta7 inputs as heading-related and notes that Delta7 is glutamatergic and appears sign-inverting on many downstream targets. This literature context is not substituted for a receptor-resolved MaleCNS effective-sign authority.

claim_boundary: This authority only constrains modeled presynaptic sign assumptions for the heading lane. It does not qualify heading tuning, preferred angles, effective Delta7 sign, neural dynamics, PFL3 comparison, steering, or behavior.
